fact: On 13 March 2025, after eight months of preparation, the national AI strategy was officially handed to the Prime Minister for government adoption and upcoming launch.

The article says the investment amount required to implement the strategy had not yet been disclosed (published 2025-03-14); a National Committee for AI and Data Governance is listed as an initial action, not yet set up.

The Ministry of Digital Transition issued the 71-page SNIA 2030 in 2024 with forewords signed by the Prime Minister and the minister; it sets a 2030 vision, three pillars and a roadmap, and says it will create a National AI Agency.

fact: The article refers to Côte d'Ivoire's existing national AI strategy as being turned into projects, with a three-year AI roadmap to follow; the document gives no adoption date and is published 2026-09-14.
At the close of IMPACT IA on 11 September 2026 the minister said the government would accelerate implementation of a national AI strategy, with a budgeted roadmap expected within three weeks.
GRAIN's comparative study of four West African countries says Côte d'Ivoire has adopted its AI strategy to the 2030 horizon (no adoption date given; article published 2026-08-10).

A seminar on 2026-04-12 in Yamoussoukro, led by Minister Djibril Ouattara, discussed harmonising existing national strategies including the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy, treated as an existing strategy.
